evals.prompt: Write a PRD from plugins/project-advisor/skills/to-prd/evals/inputs/brief-bundle-review-notes.md. Conduct a short interview. Ask each round, use your recommendations as my answers, and continue without waiting. Research repository facts yourself. Accept and publish the PRD.
evals.expected_output: A published action-items/PRD-<slug>/ bundle whose design_tree records asked questions, statuses, and settled-node sources.
expectations: A published bundle exists under action-items/PRD-<slug>/ and contains index.html, prd.yaml, and local assets.
The published prd.yaml declares schema_version 2 and carries a non-empty design_tree block.
Every design_tree node has an id, short label, question, and settled, pruned, or deferred status; NODE-* ids publish as node-*.
Recorded questions match the interview verbatim and remain questions rather than answer summaries.
Every settled node carries an answer, a source, and a rationale.
At least one researched node uses source research and evidence with real repository paths, such as bundle assets.
At least one node answered by the user names source user.
Note storage format is absent or pruned with a reason because it is an implementation decision.
The unanswerable review-portal question appears in open_questions; any matching tree node is deferred and relates_to it.
The tree stays at PRD altitude: no node records a code-level or implementation choice as a settled product decision.
Dependent decisions are children of their prerequisite decision rather than root nodes.
The published prd.yaml reads status: Accepted, because the agent accepted the PRD at the review gate.
The manifest requirements and decisions stay consistent with the brief's settled decisions: a note belongs to one section and stays on the reviewer's machine.

evals.prompt: Revise plugins/project-advisor/skills/to-prd/evals/inputs/prd-bundle-review-notes.yaml. A reviewer can now export notes and send the file to a colleague, so notes are not local-only. Use your recommended follow-up answers without waiting. Publish the revision in review.
evals.expected_output: A republished bundle whose design_tree preserves node ids, records the current answer, and stores the earlier answer in superseded_answer.
expectations: The revised prd.yaml keeps node-01, node-02, and node-03 with their original meanings.
The note-location node states the new answer and keeps the local-only answer as superseded_answer.
The tree states the current shared understanding: no settled node still presents the replaced answer as the answer.
Each new revision question has a new NODE-* id, question, status, and source.
The pruned storage-format node stays pruned and keeps its reason.
The problem statement, REQ-01, TEST-01, and open question remain unchanged.
The published prd.yaml is not Accepted because the revision returns it to review.
Validation, generation, and inspection of the revised manifest pass.
